Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished illustration of Liu Bei of the Three Kingdoms personified as a beautiful adult human woman, in a polished glossy 2D anime gacha character illustration style. Brand-new image from text only.

STYLE: Polished Japanese-anime gacha character illustration in clean 2D: crisp thin dark linework, large finely detailed glossy eyes with layered highlights and a soft blush, very fine detailed hair rendered as many thin strands with sparkling highlights along every lock, soft airy cel-to-gradient shading with a natural sunlit sheen — soft, broad highlights from real outdoor daylight on her skin, gloves, stockings and armor, never wet, oily or plastic-looking, and a bright high-key look where the highlights glow toward white while the darkest accents stay deep and clean. A low-saturation pastel palette dominated by white, silver and soft light tones, with one deep accent colour; gentle bloom and small sparkle particles in the air. Keep the face and body visibly illustrated in 2D; no 3D render or photorealistic appearance.

CHARACTER: A single woman, the female personification of Liu Bei (유비), the benevolent founder of Shu Han, who swore sisterhood in the Peach Garden; her nature: benevolence and humility that win hearts, humble straw-sandal beginnings under imperial Han blood, long jade earrings as her mark of fortune, the twin swords of the Peach Garden oath, tears shed for her people. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. A refined, beautiful face — oval face, almond-shaped eyes, realistically proportioned eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward, soft rounded brows, straight narrow nose, full wide lips, a bare, makeup-free face; a soft, gentle warmth; expression: a warm, gentle look with a faint smile. Eyes and skin: amber eyes, warm beige skin. Hair: muted, low-saturation warm chestnut-brown hair, long straight hair, center-parted bangs framing the face. Graceful, curvaceous adult physique — curvy; balanced natural proportions around 7.5 heads tall and a natural neck.

COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT: Elaborate command-type mecha armour with aged-gold ornamentation: sculpted angular shoulder units with command fins, layered hard-surface plates with engraved borders, a fitted armoured bodice with an emblem core and a structured waist, articulated armoured skirts and rigid cape-like binder plates, heeled armoured boots. A crowned command head unit with a small antenna crest sits behind her hair, leaving her face fully visible. Faction mecha design: jade-green and white plating with imperial-gold trims, organic layered armor like overlapping leaves, a resilient all-terrain frame, warm green glow lines; the plating reads as solid engraved metal armour, not cloth. Overall silhouette: a large ring halo behind her head and a tall crown-like head unit, with long hanging shoulder plates — a ceremonial, elegant shape — only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely. Colours: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade — rendered within a low-saturation white-and-silver pastel palette, the deepest of these as the single deep accent colour. Armour, silk and leather carry a soft, broad natural sunlit sheen, never wet, oily or plastic-looking. Far-future mecha design. EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume described above, its material and palette. Signature item: a pair of matched twin swords in one double scabbard, its entire length visible within the composition.

COMPOSITION AND SCENE: Single vertical 2:3 full-body illustration, head to boots visible with comfortable margins. A composed, heroic standing pose, slightly turned toward the viewer. One hand naturally grips her signature item beside her — if it is a long weapon, held upright with its butt resting on the ground — fully visible within the composition; the other hand rests openly beside her hip, clearly separated from the torso. Setting: inside a vast glass dome over terraced gardens, a ringed gas giant hanging in the sky above — softly rendered, it provides depth without competing with her face and silhouette. Her hair and the loose fabric of her costume drift in a gentle breeze. Bright high-key daylight with soft bloom and small sparkles reveals her face, the costume and hair; glossy 2D anime gacha character illustration.

ANATOMY AND FINISH: One head, exactly two arms and two legs. Both natural human hands visible, five fingers on each hand, anatomically correct grip and clear wrists. No extra limbs, missing hands or cropped weapon. No other characters, text, lettering, logos, watermark, border or UI.
